Game Overview

Detto Man is a adventure game built around guide a charming robot through vibrant 2D levels, collecting oranges and mastering double jumps to outwit tricky obstacles and formidable foes. Each level escalates the challenge with cunning traps and enemies, ensuring that strategic agility and perfect timing are essential for success in this delightful platforming adventure.
